recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構被單一型態、中等大小的淋巴球瀰漫性取代，細胞核略不規則、染色質細緻，部分有明顯核仁與核分裂（多形性變異型的線索）；免疫染色可見瀰漫性強核染色（符合 cyclin D1／SOX11／p53 類型）及偏高的增生指數，支持具不良預後特徵的被套細胞淋巴瘤（mantle cell lymphoma）。
features: Diffuse effacement of nodal architecture by a monotonous lymphoid infiltrate around a hyalinized vessel
Medium-sized to larger cells with slightly irregular/cleaved nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and small but distinct nucleoli in a subset (pleomorphic features)
Scant pale cytoplasm; scattered mitotic figures; occasional pink histiocytes
Touch imprint: sheets of monotonous medium-to-large cells with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli

IHC: diffuse strong membranous B-cell-type staining, diffuse strong nuclear staining in most tumor cells, and a proliferation-type nuclear stain positive in a substantial fraction (stains not labeled on images)
Scattered granular-cytoplasm positive background cells on one stain, with tumor cells negative
describe_en: Sections of lymph node show diffuse effacement of the architecture by a monotonous proliferation of lymphoid cells surrounding a hyalinized vessel. At high power the cells are medium to large, with slightly irregular nuclear contours, finely dispersed chromatin, small distinct nucleoli in a subset and scant cytoplasm; mitotic figures are readily found, and a touch imprint shows a corresponding population of monotonous blastoid-to-pleomorphic cells. Immunohistochemical stains (not labeled on the images) show diffuse membranous positivity in the neoplastic cells, diffuse strong nuclear positivity in the majority of cells, and a nuclear proliferation stain highlighting a substantial fraction of cells, with scattered non-neoplastic reactive cells. In the context of cyclin D1 and SOX11 expression with p53 overexpression and Ki-67 >30%, the findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma with pleomorphic features and adverse prognostic markers.

ddx.vs: Pleomorphic MCL can mimic DLBCL morphologically, but MCL is cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive with t(11;14), whereas DLBCL is cyclin D1 negative (or only weak in rare CD5+ cases) and SOX11 negative.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma with proliferation centers
ddx.vs: CLL/SLL shows small round cells with clumped chromatin, paler proliferation centers with paraimmunoblasts, CD23 and LEF1 positivity, and lacks cyclin D1 and SOX11.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma expresses TdT (and often CD34) and lacks cyclin D1, while blastoid MCL is TdT negative and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive.

ddx.dx: Cyclin D1-positive plasma cell neoplasm or hairy cell leukemia
ddx.vs: These may express cyclin D1 but differ in morphology (plasmacytoid cells or abundant cytoplasm with hairy projections), are SOX11 negative, and have distinct immunophenotypes (CD138 or CD103/CD25/annexin A1).
